newsitem.title: USA: Trans World sets four-day air fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Trans World sets four-day air fare sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday it had set fare sales for flights between 12 U.S. cities and select destinations in the United States, Canada and the Caribbean.
TWA also announced a four-day sale for travel from Boston and New York to eight international destinations.
All tickets must be purchased by September 13.
In the U.S., Canada and the Caribbean, fares are as low as $198 for a round-trip, such as between Charlotte, N.C., and Boston.
New York-to-Seattle is priced at $316 round-trip, and Minneapolis-St. Paul to San Juan, Puerto Rico, is $338 round-trip.

The sale covers travel to and from New York's Kennedy International Airport, Charlotte, Boston, Philadelphia, Raleigh-Durham, N.C., Austin, San Antonio, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Washington, Columbia, Mo., Peoria, Ill., and Toronto.
TWA said the sales do not apply to flights originating from or headed to St. Louis.
TWA said the best discounts are available Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. All travel must be completed by December 18. A Saturday night stay is required.
Travel to Las Vegas/Reno requires a two-day minimum stay and San Juan requires a three-day minimum stay.
Sale fares are not available on November 23 and 27 and December 1 and 2.
Internationally, TWA said roundtrip fares are as low as $346 from Boston to Paris. The fare between Boston/New York and Madrid is $404, and between Boston/New York and Athens is $472.
Fares are valid for travel beginning November 4. Travel must be completed by December 18. Sale fares require a five-day minimum stay.
